entries.title: Official forest-to-farm task
entries.label: Source scope
entries.passage: The prompt asks for a food web tracking forest conversion, returning species, chemical management and an organic-farming decision letter.
entries.uncertainty: The prompt’s herbicide-only question differs from the paper’s broader pesticide-withdrawal treatment.

entries.title: From forest to farm
entries.label: 2025 Contest Research
entries.passage: The paper frames conversion as a disturbance that changes habitat and relationships sustaining agricultural production.

entries.title: The food web
entries.label: 2025 Contest Research
entries.passage: The paper links producers, consumer levels and decomposers through energy and nutrient flows.
entries.uncertainty: The conceptual diagram supplies no calibrated interaction coefficients.

entries.title: Ecological dynamics model
entries.label: 2025 Contest Research
entries.passage: Eq. 7 includes age transport, population interactions, stochastic forcing and delay. Fig. 5 summarizes the AED framework.
entries.uncertainty: Age grids, histories and sufficient fitted inputs are missing. The portfolio’s teaching model is separate.

entries.title: Seasonality and FPI
entries.label: Reported 2025 results
entries.passage: The paper reports a decline in producer and consumer species counts followed by partial recovery. Fig. 7 charts a separate ordinal energy index across farm stages.
entries.uncertainty: The input series and physical energy units are unavailable. The results have not been independently reproduced.

entries.title: Returning native species
entries.label: Reported 2025 results
entries.passage: The study models dandelions and snails joining the existing system. Fig. 8 plots the paper’s modeled density trajectories.
entries.uncertainty: Numerical initial states and usable histories are missing. The trajectories have not been independently reproduced.

entries.title: Pesticide withdrawal
entries.label: Reported 2025 results
entries.passage: Eq. 10 combines growth, interaction, a reference-state term and exposure-dependent loss. The paper discusses broad pesticide removal. The prompt asks about herbicide removal.
entries.uncertainty: The archive lacks a dose schedule and a distinct herbicide-only comparison. The scenario has not been independently reproduced.

entries.title: Bats and bees
entries.label: Reported 2025 results
entries.passage: The paper compares separate bat and bee scenarios. Its summary reports reductions in disturbance sensitivity of 11% and 35%, respectively.
entries.uncertainty: These are reported model claims. The archive lacks species-specific calibration, independently reproduced trajectories and field validation.

entries.title: Organic farm indicators
entries.label: 2025 Contest Research
entries.passage: The 5D-OFE framework uses environmental conditions, ecological metrics, crop parameters, policy economics and soil fertility.
entries.uncertainty: The archive lacks the complete input matrix.

entries.title: Reported weighting methods
entries.label: 2025 Contest Research
entries.passage: The paper presents AHP, entropy weighting, CRITIC and a combined weighting figure.
entries.uncertainty: Judgment and input matrices and a reproducible final fusion rule are missing.

entries.title: Milkwood objectives and ranking
entries.label: Reported 2025 results
entries.passage: The paper describes environmental and economic objectives and reports applying NSGA-II and TOPSIS to the Milkwood case.
entries.uncertainty: Candidates, full variable mappings and ranking settings are unavailable. The result has not been independently reproduced.

entries.title: Published forecast
entries.label: Reported 2025 results
entries.passage: The paper names ARIMA(2,1,2) and plots a 15-year scenario with sustainability and monetary series.
entries.uncertainty: Training data, fitted coefficients and independent forecast checks are missing. The chart has not been independently reproduced and does not establish actual revenue.

entries.title: Reported sensitivity study
entries.label: Reported 2025 results
entries.passage: The paper varies linear and nonlinear factors by 10% and plots sensitivity index distributions.
entries.uncertainty: Baselines, the sensitivity metric and individual runs are unavailable. The result does not establish global stability.

entries.title: Farmer recommendations
entries.label: Reported 2025 recommendations
entries.passage: The letter proposes restoration areas and nitrogen-fixing plants, soil monitoring, nets and habitat for natural pest enemies, and tourism or education as prospective revenue sources.
entries.uncertainty: Radar inputs and baselines are unavailable. Proposals and projected timelines do not establish observed outcomes or certification.

entries.title: Equation 9 state-symbol mismatch
entries.label: Audited source anomaly
entries.passage: Eq. 8 names the fourth state Q. Eq. 9 writes W in the initial conditions.
entries.uncertainty: The source does not resolve the mismatch or supply numeric initial conditions.

entries.title: Equation 17 cost expression
entries.label: Audited source anomaly
entries.passage: The printed cost expression satisfies the initial value but generally fails the cost differential equation in Eq. 16.
entries.uncertainty: The portal documents the discrepancy and leaves the printed equation intact.

entries.title: Equation 27 malformed coefficient
entries.label: Audited source anomaly
entries.passage: Eq. 27 prints a malformed coefficient for the environmental objective.
entries.uncertainty: Its intended value is not established in the source archive.

entries.title: Data and validation limits
entries.label: Audited source gap
entries.passage: The paper lists external data portals and discusses limitations. The audit found no complete raw observations, calibrated inputs or archived forecast training data.
entries.uncertainty: Reported model outcomes remain separate from field validation and independent reproduction.
